notes.title: Spooky Time Sale
notes.notes:
Spooky Time!

I've recently finished the Silent Hill 2 Remake to 100%, and it reminded me how much I really love that series and I would highly recommend it to anyone who loves horror.

Meanwhile, It is that time of year and so A Spider to a Fly is back on deep discount (Super Cheap!) which was inspired by the first Silent Hill game (back on PS1!)

After a few fixes and tweaks since launch, now might be the best time to dive into this short, but Atmospheric Psychological-Horror/Adventure, currently cheaper than a ride on a bus ;)

Thanks all!

notes.title: UPDATE - Version 1.2!
notes.notes:
A new update should be available for all now! (you may need to validate your installation)

- A [b]new [/b]"destination marker" was added, for easier navigation.

- [b]Removed [/b]60fps cap, The game will now sync with your monitors' refresh rate (so, uncapped - but 24fps cap is still available for [b]"a e s t h e t i c s"[/b] )

- [b]New [/b]resolution scaling, support for [b]16:10[/b] and beyond (not been able to test with ultrawide, but the fix should scale)

- [b]Fixed [/b]the "Trying to Remember" achievement not unlocking for some players. (This will likely require a new playthrough. Apologies for the inconvenience) 

- [b]Resolved [/b]issues caused when using Alt-Tab during certain cutscenes.

- [b]Scene transitions[/b] have been [b]overhauled [/b]to be faster, more slick and less distracting,
 
- Text/dialogue display timings have been tweaked across the game.

- Additional small bug fixes & some lighting improvements

Thank you all for your feedback and support!

Please let me know of any issues in the Steam forums.

Many thanks,

Syine.

notes.title: Reduce the Darkness
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787500/019558a29d61da41a91411ebe30f10959070c83f.png[/img]

Okay, so just a small update with a much-requested feature;


Seems a lot of you have struggled with the game's brightness (or lack thereof) and so I have added a new "Darkness" bar on the Pause Menu. This is set to max as standard, and you can now reduce the amount of darkness in the game :)

A few other small tweaks, but that's it.

Thank you all so much for playing A Spider to A Fly, and please consider leaving a review if you haven't already!

Many thanks,

Syine.

notes.title: Achievements Added!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787500/0155cb58a0cabee3be29c38b05f403c374c5dcca.png[/img]

[b][u]Achievements are Here![/u][/b]

Hey all, I've been working on adding Achievements to A Spider to A Fly, as well as some other key improvements, and I'm happy to finally drop this update today!

There are now [b]12 new Achievements[/b] in the game (You will need to start a new game to get them all) 5 Normal and 7 Hidden (Returning players may want to explore again!)

I have also made some small improvements to gameplay, visuals, and some lighting, along with some minor bugs and 1 major (sorry) megabug. 

But the other big thing is the [b][u]removal of the 24fps cap[/u][/b];

This cap was deliberate as an [i]"artistic"[/i] choice, but I believe it was the culprit for some players feeling the game felt too slow/had blurry visuals. 

The cap is now set to 60fps, as I found the game didn't "feel" right on anything higher. There is also now an option to turn the cap back on to 24fps if you like it (I do).

Many thanks for your support and feedback, please do keep letting me know of any issues you may have in the discussions tabs.

Syine.

(If your game doesn't auto-update with the new build, please verify the files - Right-click the game in Steam, select "properties", then "Installed Files", and then "Verify Integrity of the game files". This should update the game.)

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi, thank you all so much for all the feedback and bug-spotting! Sorry for any inconvenience caused, and please do continue to tell me of any issues you find.

Patch 1.01: 

- Starting a "New Game" immediately after finishing the game now correctly resets the game state

- Certain Items can no longer be picked up twice

- Corrected various spelling errors

- Improved visibility for certain Pick-ups

- Various Scene improvements and interaction fixes

I am currently looking to implement Steam Achievements, but this may take some time.

Thanks again to all who have supported the game so far, I hope this little update improves your experiences.

Happy New Year!
